messages.text:
"Create a fully functional 2D Fantasy Action MOBA game with professional game design, competitive gameplay, and deep strategic mechanics. The game must feature 20 unique playable heroes divided into six roles: Tank, Fighter, Assassin, Mage, Marksman, and Support. Each hero must have a unique character design, backstory, attributes, combat style, basic attack, four unique active/passive abilities, an ultimate ability, cooldowns, mana or energy costs, and distinctive visual effects and animations. Every hero must have different strengths, weaknesses, and playstyles to ensure meaningful gameplay diversity. Include a complete hero selection system, hero leveling, EXP progression, gold economy, attribute upgrades, and in-match skill upgrades. Create a complete item shop containing at least 40 items across categories such as Physical Attack, Magic Power, Defense, Movement, Critical Damage, Lifesteal, Penetration, Cooldown Reduction, and Utility. Every item must have its own price, statistics, passive effects, active abilities, synergies, and recommended builds for different heroes. Design a detailed top-down 2D battle arena featuring three lanes (Top, Mid, and Bottom), jungle areas, neutral monsters, Blue and Red Buffs, minions, defensive turrets, inhibitors, and main bases. Implement automatic minion waves, last-hitting, farming, jungling, HP and mana regeneration, fog of war, hidden bushes, respawn mechanics, and base destruction objectives. Include 5v5 matches against AI opponents and allies, with multiplayer functionality if supported, matchmaking, hero selection, scoreboard, kill/death/assist statistics, match history, minimap, HP and mana indicators, skill cooldown displays, gold counters, and an interactive item shop. Provide responsive virtual joystick controls optimized for Android devices. Develop intelligent AI teammates and enemies capable of farming, defending lanes, attacking turrets, performing ganks, retreating when health is low, and coordinating team fights. Add equipment systems, emblems, talents, runes, achievements, ranked modes, leaderboards, tutorials, graphics and audio settings, sound effects, background music, attack animations, skill effects, floating damage numbers, and a modern, intuitive HUD. Ensure balanced hero statistics, meaningful skill interactions, item counters, strategic synergies, and a reliable balancing system that prevents any hero or item from becoming excessively overpowered. Use high-quality pixel art or hand-drawn 2D graphics with smooth animations, detailed environments, impressive particle effects, and a consistent fantasy visual identity. The game must be genuinely playable and fully functional, not just a visual prototype or static mockup. All buttons, heroes, abilities, items, AI systems, match mechanics, and gameplay features must work correctly and interact with one another. Optimize performance for Android devices with 4 GB RAM, include a persistent player progression and save system, and support offline gameplay against AI bots, with online multiplayer functionality if technically possible.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
